note: points (x, y, t_ms) in key widths of `centers`; `lifts` = indices i with a finger lift between points[i] and points[i+1]; decode with `config`; `chars` = [code, char, weight] (all codes), `words` = [word, freq]; main code of a char = shortest code, ties by higher weight then code. Compare ranked texts exactly and scores to 1e-6. The mini lexicon holds a few hundred REAL rows from the Cangjie 3 table / essay.txt (the targets and their top-ranked competitors) plus SYNTHETIC filler (random codes, private-use characters U+E800.., random frequencies); the repository does not contain the table or the word list.
